title: Measuring the Value at Risk on a Holding Covered by a Protection Plan
content:
The value at risk on the holding a Pass and Trip Protection plan is written over is measured from the use that
holding has already had under the Season Pass Programme.

1. Where the covered holding's Season Pass Programme account carries scans in the season and cover began on or
   before the day the season opened, the value the plan covers is taken in proportion to the days of the
   season still to come, counted from the day the claim is measured from to the day cover is due to end, over
   the days the value is spread across, rounded to the cent, and never more than the value the plan covers.
2. Where the covered holding's account carries scans in the season and cover began after the day the season
   opened, the value the plan covers is reduced by the day-use deduction the covered holding's own tier sets
   for each day it has been scanned in the season, rounded to the cent, and never falls below zero.
3. In every other case — the covered holding's account carrying no scan in the season — the value the plan
   covers is taken whole.

**The records the measure is read from.** The scans are the entries the covered holding's own account under
the Season Pass Programme books each time the pass is scanned at a lift within the season the plan covers,
counted one to an entry. The deduction taken for each of those days is the day-use deduction the covered
holding's own pass tier sets.

**Worked illustrations (hypothetical inputs).** A plan covering a holding at 1000.00 USD, cover having begun
on the day the season opened, the holding's account carrying scans in the season, 60 days of cover still to
come from the day the claim is measured from, and the value spread across 150 days: the value at risk is
400.00 USD. A plan covering a holding at 1000.00 USD, cover having begun a month into the season, the
holding's account carrying 8 scans in the season and its pass tier setting a day-use deduction of 45.00 USD:
the value at risk is 640.00 USD. The same plan with 30 scans in the season: the reduction would carry the
figure below zero, so the value at risk is 0.00 USD. A plan whose covered holding's account carries no scan at
all in the season: the value at risk is the whole 1000.00 USD the plan covers.
